notes.title: 30 Years of ROTT
notes.content:
Today is February 17th, 2025.

Rise of the Triad v1.0 launched on February 17th, 1995.

You know what that means?! ROTT is 30 YEARS OLD TODAY!

[previewyoutube=Fo3sIBNgWi0;full][/previewyoutube]
From the original 90s Deadly Gentlemen to the 2010s reboot Task Force and now the Cccool coming together of Apogee, Night Dive and New Blood, it's been a long ride- and we can't thank you enough for taking it with us! :Triad:

But wait, there's more! As promised...

The LUDICROUS Lunchboxes are shipping!

[previewyoutube=9vt0UXArwgc;full][/previewyoutube]
In just a few short weeks you'll finally be able to tell people THEY'LL BURY YOU IN A LUNCHBOX :Gib:
(and have the lunchbox to back it up!)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42959933/fde017487d297a15cb54b73027e056de31722337.jpg
And last but not least - we've got a New Bundle!

You can now get...

[] The OG DOSbox version of Rise of the Triad: Dark War
[] Rise of the Triad [2013]
 Rise of the Triad: Ludicrous Edition
For one low price! 

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/35375/HUNT_Bundle/

So raise a bowl of priest porridge :Porridge: and celebrate 30 Years of ROTT with us! 

On behalf of Apogee, Night Dive, New Blood and the DEVELOPERS OF INCREDIBLE POWER! :Ankh:
